summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report) disclosing September 2026 securities and derivatives transactions by its board, executive officers, audit committee and controlling group/family dependants. No special-situation event is present. Holdings are unchanged at 3,811,582,439 common shares (35.9854% of total) and 121,067,106 non-voting shares (1.1430%) for the controlling group; insider movements were modest Bradesco brokerage purchases of non-voting shares at approximately R$17.99 and one sale at R$18.23. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, stake change or structural mechanic is implicated; watch only for governance optics.
